name: Bottle of Disease
summary: Near Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale, Forsaken alchemists brew disease. Their encampment holds bottles of virulent concoctions.

sections.title: Blight in the Sacred Woods
sections.body: Beyond the Warsong Outriders' front lines, Forsaken alchemists brew contagions near Dor'Danil Barrow Den. The bottles give the night elves at Forest Song proof of an attack aimed at the woods. The Forsaken seek to sicken the soil and wildlife instead of facing the sentinels in open combat.

sections.title: Kayneth Stillwind's Investigation
sections.body: Kayneth Stillwind is a night elf sentry at Forest Song. He seeks proof of Forsaken ambitions and wants a Bottle of Disease to study its contents. The night elves fear the mixtures could corrupt sacred barrows and break the minds and bodies of the forest's defenders.

faq.q: What is inside the Bottle of Disease?
faq.answer: Forsaken apothecaries brew synthetic poisons and magical contagions in the bottle. The Royal Apothecary Society conducts broader experiments with virulent blights.

aliases: where to find bottle of disease
faq.answer: You can find the bottles in an isolated Forsaken encampment south of Forest Song, near the entrance to Dor'Danil Barrow Den in eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who wants the Bottle of Disease?
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf protector at Forest Song, wants you to retrieve a bottle. He hopes to test its contents and learn the Horde's intentions.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken brewing diseases in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The night elves suspect the Forsaken mean to infect the sacred forest and desecrate nearby barrow dens. They fear this will poison the ecosystem and weaken night elven resistance from within.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know undead contagion on Ashenvale's soil is an unforgivable affront, especially near Dor'Danil Barrow Den.
As a druid, you know blighted mixtures and artificial plagues oppose natural balance. Act swiftly to preserve the woodland.
